note: No Instagram account connected. Trends are what is currently popular in these three domains, not a platform-wide census.
source: public Instagram trend discovery (social.search, platform=instagram, ranked by engagement)

trends.details: A 6.1K-like reel presents 'the perfect little holiday outfit' — a sheer black long-sleeve top dotted with white pearls layered over a black bodysuit, a silver sequin midi skirt with a front slit, dangling crystal earrings, and a small black feathered clutch with a pearl handle; the same top then pairs with black high-waisted wide-leg trousers and a small white shoulder bag for a second look. A 4.1K-like reel, posted today, runs seven all-black holiday outfits — a black satin sleeveless top with a sheer sequined midi skirt, a black long-sleeve top with sequin shorts and black tights, an oversized black turtleneck over a sheer tulle maxi skirt, a black velvet sequined wrap jumpsuit, a black feather-trimmed sweater with a satin midi skirt, a black lace long-sleeve mini dress over a slip, and a black sequin long-sleeve mini dress with tights, finished with gold jewelry, red lipstick, and small handbags. A 12K-like 'Festive outfits for EVERYbody' try-on pairs two women, size 14 and size 24, in five coordinated looks — matching black sequined mini dresses with feather hems; silver sequin skirts with light blue button-up shirts; black velvet corset-style tops with voluminous white tulle midi skirts; matching burgundy velvet long-sleeve mini dresses; and black long-sleeve tops with black sequin maxi skirts. A 5.6K-like try-on preps for an Old Navy holiday party with three options — a navy turtleneck mini dress with a tan belt, black tights, and cream heeled boots; a red top with dark pinstripe wide-leg pants and a gray faux-fur jacket; and a black corset top with a zebra-print maxi skirt and black fur shrug, settling on the third. A 2.8K-like 'BUY OR BYEEE?' try-on runs five holiday looks — a white sparkly camisole with loose gray trousers and a white sequined feathered jacket; a magenta sequin sleeveless jumpsuit with feather trim; a red-and-blue plaid mini dress with ruffled sleeves; a black strapless studded velvet peplum top with black faux-leather wide-leg pants; and a sheer white sleeveless peplum top over a gold bralette. A 1.5K-like Friendsgiving pick-me runs five looks — a black floral corset bodysuit with side cutouts and dark jeans; a red strapless corset mini dress with knee-high boots; a shimmering gold halter mini dress; a burgundy plaid puff-sleeve mini dress; and a dramatic red off-the-shoulder gown with a long train. A 4.3K-like H&M lookbook models seven looks — a white sequined mock-neck top with a black satin midi skirt and gold belt; a black sparkly mini dress with an open back; a black strapless velvet midi dress with bust cutouts; a black tweed blazer and shorts set with tights; a black dress with a large white bow at the neckline; and a white sequined peplum top with black trousers. A 2K-like 'SKIRT vs TROUSERS' comparison runs four pairings — a black sequin slip midi dress against a burgundy strapless peplum top with matching wide-leg satin trousers; a black sleeveless maxi gown with a cape against a black one-shoulder bow top with silver sequin wide-leg trousers; a white button-down with a gold sequin midi skirt against a sheer white embellished blouse with champagne satin trousers; and a silver satin top with a large-disc silver sequin skirt against a silver beaded fringe tank with white wide-leg trousers.
trends.title: All-black holiday looks, pearl sheer tops, and festive try-ons for every body

trends.details: A 42K-like reel builds three large-scale Christmas DIYs — a giant red hot cocoa mug from styrofoam, a spray-painted planter, and a pool noodle, finished with a snowflake decal, a candy cane stirrer, and marshmallows; an illuminated winter village wreath of white lights, expanding-foam snow, wooden house cutouts, and bottle-brush trees; and a giant gingerbread sundae in a green urn with a painted gingerbread-man cutout, peppermint candies, and sprinkles. A 91K-like reel, posted today, crowns a tall heavily ornamented tree with a large glowing gold star topper — the creator, in dark green gingerbread-man pajamas, swaps the old star for the illuminated one and steps back to admire it. A 23K-like DIY builds an indoor greenery trellis on the curved white wall of a grand foyer staircase — a diamond lattice of thin floral wire, cedar garland branches tied along the lines, green ribbon bows at each intersection, and delicate clear icicle ornaments, framing an arched niche with white roses. A 10K-like slow pan tours a warmly lit home under the overlay 'The best homes feel collected, not decorated' — a dining table with a red runner and a tree with gold ribbons, a banquette with Santa pillows and a tree with dried fruit slices, a dark green sectional, and a fireplace mantel lined with stockings spelling 'CHRISTMAS,' greenery, and miniature houses. A 28K-like montage, captioned 'My husband and I decorating for Christmas,' drapes greenery over a stone fireplace mantel, assembles a large flocked tree, hangs personalized stockings, decorates two tall trees (one red and white, one black, white, and silver), and dresses the kitchen and living room with garland, nutcracker pillows, and a nutcracker duvet. A 15K-like reel documents a family's second tree — the bedroom tree — unboxing needlepoint ornaments of the 12 Days of Christmas characters, a dried orange slice garland, burgundy velvet bows, mercury glass balls, and gingerbread house ornaments, topped with a white star. A 19K-like 17-slide carousel tours a Washington D.C. red-brick townhouse at Christmas — snowy exterior with green wreaths tied with large red velvet bows, a tall tree with gold, silver, and red ornaments, a formal dining room, a bar cart, and whimsical mushroom, moon, and star ornaments. A 15K-like 'decorate over chores' reel hangs colorful paper chain garlands, adds velvet bows and dried orange slices to wreaths, dresses a range hood with greenery, sets up a hot cocoa bar cart, and decorates a lit tree with pom-poms and ribbons while 'Home Alone' plays above the fireplace.
trends.title: Giant cocoa-mug DIYs, a glowing star topper, and collected Christmas homes

trends.details: A 250K-like tutorial, the day's biggest beauty post, plays 'Christmas Filters Choose My Makeup' — an AR filter cycles through holiday effects and the creator recreates each one for real: a white base on the lids, brown eyeshadow, bright red winged eyeliner, pale blue-gray shading under the eyes with yellow star accents, and a bold red lip over a darker wine-colored liner. A 37K-like extreme close-up paints a cartoon reindeer face onto the eyelid — a red glitter heart at the outer corner, bold red winged liner above and below the eye, a brown reindeer face with antlers and a red nose, white snowflakes and dots, and false lashes, set to 'Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer.' A 10K-like 'Holiday glam eyeshadow tutorial' builds dramatic pink and burgundy smoky eyes with a bright shimmery center from the Blend Bunny Undertones palette, lined with a neon yellow pencil on the lower waterline and finished with a glossy brown lip. A 3.3K-like 'EASY CHRISTMAS LIGHTS MAKEUP!!' draws a winding string of lights across the forehead and cheek with black liquid liner, then dabs teardrop bulbs in red, green, blue, and yellow with a cotton swab and adds white dots above each bulb for glow, finished with dark red liquid lipstick. A 7.8K-like '3 Easy Christmas Makeup Hacks' paints three cheek designs with a cotton swab — a Christmas pudding, a gold coin, and a Christmas cookie in red and green dots. A 7.1K-like 'CHRISTMAS FILTERS CHOOSE MY MAKEUP' challenge lets the filter dictate bright pink and green eyeshadow, white 'dripping snow' liner, solid white lips, snowflakes over the eyebrows, and a miniature winter scene — a cabin, trees, and snow — painted on the lips as a 'scenic lip.' An 8.9K-like full transformation runs start to finish — brows, Drunk Elephant Protini prep, e.l.f. Camo underpainting, Dior bronzer, Huda Beauty setting powder, individual lashes, Merit 'Fox' blush, and MAC Chestnut liner with gloss — ending in a soft-glam look with warm smoky eyes and glossy nude lips. A 2.6K-like 'Holiday Party Makeup' tutorial runs a full face — liquid foundation, concealer, setting powder, contour, pink-toned Dior eyeshadow, lip liner, curled lashes, two mascaras, blush, and highlighter.
trends.title: Christmas filters choose the makeup — red wings, star accents, and Rudolph eyes
